description: This file implements real-time event broadcasting for a Flask application, supporting WebSocket and Server-Sent Events (SSE) for test run updates. It manages WebSocket clients and SSE subscribers, broadcasting events such as run status and logs, and provides endpoints for WebSocket connections and SSE streams.

classes.name: _EventHub
classes.description: A thread-safe in-memory pub-sub hub managing WebSocket clients and SSE subscribers, broadcasting events to them.

methods.name: add_ws
methods.description: Adds a WebSocket client to the hub.

methods.name: remove_ws
methods.description: Removes a WebSocket client from the hub.

methods.name: add_sse
methods.description: Registers a new SSE subscriber and returns its ID.

methods.name: remove_sse
methods.description: Removes an SSE subscriber by ID.

methods.name: _notify_sse
methods.description: Appends a frame to all SSE subscriber buffers and notifies them.

methods.name: _serialize_ws
methods.description: Serializes a BroadcastEvent into a JSON string for WebSocket transmission.

methods.name: _serialize_sse
methods.description: Serializes a BroadcastEvent into an SSE-formatted string.

methods.name: broadcast
methods.description: Broadcasts an event to all WebSocket and SSE clients.

methods.name: pull_sse_frames
methods.description: Generator yielding SSE frames for a subscriber, blocking until new frames are available.

methods.name: init_app_for_realtime
methods.description: Initializes WebSocket and SSE routes in the Flask app, and exposes a broadcaster function.

methods.name: register_ws_routes
methods.description: Registers WebSocket route for real-time event streaming if Flask-Sock is available.
